task.title: View login attempts (current user)
task.shortdesc: You can view station or platform login attempts for your user account or for any user that you have admin read-level access to. You can use or a browser to view current user login and user login history that includes successful and unsuccessful login attempts.

li.p: To view user login history you need to have a or a browser connection to the station or a connection to the platform you are interested in monitoring.
To view information about users other than yourself, you need to have admin privileges that apply to the user you are monitoring.

context.p: There are several ways for you to view previous login attempts on station or a platform that you have access to. In some scenarios this is a convenience but in others it is a valuable security feature that provides a way to detect that a user may be attacking your account with malicious login attempts. The following content describes how you can use this feature.

step.cmd: Open the Session Info window to view your current login information by choosing one of the following:

chhead.chdeschd: See current session information for platform or station

chrow.chdesc: Right-click on the connected platform and choose Session Info from the menu.
Right-click on the connected station and choose Session Info from the menu.

step.stepresult: The Session Info window opens and displays your current connection information and user name at the top and the previous login time at the bottom of the window.

step.cmd: Open the User Login History window to view the user login History for your current user login by clicking the History link at the bottom of the window.
step.stepresult: The User Login History for ... window opens, displaying up to 20 of the latest previous login attempts, both successful and unsuccessful.

steps.stepsection: Browser connection: To view user login history from a web browser connection follow the steps below:

step.cmd: Click the user icon in the top right corner of the browser and select View Login History from the dropdown menu.
step.stepresult: The User Login History window displays for the currently logged-in user.

step.cmd: In , open the User Service, as follows: Expand ConfigServicesUserService.
Right-click on the desired user name and select View Login History.
step.stepresult: The User Login History window opens, displaying up to the last 20 login attempts, both successful and unsuccessful. With admin read permissions, a user can view the login history of other users.
